b1-industrializacion-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Why Make Things at Home?
b1-industrializacion-01.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos watched a documentary about the economy of Latin America in the 1930s, and he asks why the countries began to make their own products.
b1-industrializacion-01.prompt: Tell Carlos what the crisis of 1929 did to trade.
cues: Say that the countries bought fewer foreign products
Give the cause with a formal connector
b1-industrializacion-01.target: Debido a la crisis de 1929, los países pudieron comprar menos productos del extranjero.
b1-industrializacion-01.english: Because of the crisis of 1929, the countries could buy fewer foreign products.
b1-industrializacion-01.canDo: I can explain why countries began to make things at home.

b1-industrializacion-02.title: Communicative Challenge: State Companies and Factories
b1-industrializacion-02.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos visited an exhibition about the industry of Mexico and Brazil, and he asks how the governments made imported cars more expensive.
b1-industrializacion-02.prompt: Tell Carlos how the governments did it.
cues: Say what happened to imported cars
b1-industrializacion-02.target: Mediante aranceles altos, los gobiernos hacían más caros los autos importados.
b1-industrializacion-02.english: By means of high tariffs, governments made imported cars more expensive.
b1-industrializacion-02.canDo: I can name the state companies that were created, such as Pemex and Petrobras.

b1-industrializacion-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Leaving the Countryside
b1-industrializacion-03.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg were in a class about the migration to the cities in Latin America, and she asks you what changed for the peasants.
b1-industrializacion-03.prompt: Tell Meg what millions of people stopped doing.
cues: Say that millions of people stopped living somewhere
b1-industrializacion-03.target: Millones de personas dejaron de vivir en el campo y se fueron a las ciudades.
b1-industrializacion-03.english: Millions of people stopped living in the countryside and went to the cities.
b1-industrializacion-03.canDo: I can explain why people left the countryside for the cities.

b1-industrializacion-04.title: Communicative Challenge: New Neighbourhoods
b1-industrializacion-04.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos watched a documentary about the favelas of Brazil, and he asks what happened to some of those neighbourhoods.
b1-industrializacion-04.prompt: Tell Carlos how some neighbourhoods changed.
cues: Say that they became part of the city
Say what happened to them with time
b1-industrializacion-04.target: Algunos barrios se hicieron más grandes y se convirtieron en una parte normal de la ciudad.
b1-industrializacion-04.english: Some neighbourhoods grew bigger and became a normal part of the city.
b1-industrializacion-04.canDo: I can describe the neighbourhoods built by their own residents: favelas, villas and barriadas.

b1-industrializacion-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Results and Limits
b1-industrializacion-05.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg have just read a chapter about the industry of Latin America, and she asks you for the balance.
b1-industrializacion-05.prompt: Tell Meg that the region had achievements but also problems.
cues: Say that the region still had problems
b1-industrializacion-05.target: A pesar de estos logros, la región tenía problemas.
b1-industrializacion-05.english: Despite these achievements, the region had problems.
b1-industrializacion-05.canDo: I can say what Latin America manufactured by the 1960s.

b1-industrializacion-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Industrialization: A Summary
b1-industrializacion-consolidation.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos have just finished a unit on the industrialization of Latin America, and he asks you for a short summary.
b1-industrializacion-consolidation.prompt: Tell Carlos why countries made things at home and what the result was.
cues: Give the cause with a formal connector
Say that the region still had problems
b1-industrializacion-consolidation.target: Debido a la crisis de 1929, los países empezaron a fabricar en casa. A pesar de los logros, la región tenía problemas.
b1-industrializacion-consolidation.english: Because of the crisis of 1929, the countries began to make things at home. Despite the achievements, the region had problems.
b1-industrializacion-consolidation.canDo: I can sum up the causes and results of import substitution.
